name: Money, payments and escrow
definition: Create money-like liabilities or discharge/secure payment obligations.
inclusion_test: A unit targets monetary use, or a service undertakes payment delivery as its financial purpose.
exclusion_test: Incidental transfers inside another function do not add a payment-service label. Trading the unit is exchange; external backing is a facet.

name: Exchange and trade execution
definition: Exchange existing exposures and organize price discovery or execution for traders.
inclusion_test: A service matches, prices, routes or settles a trade.
exclusion_test: Primary capital raising adds CAP; writing a derivative adds DER.
principal_dependencies: ["price impact", "adverse selection", "ordering", "token behavior", "solver competition", "authorization", "venue adapters", "chain finality"]

name: Credit and financing
definition: Advance purchasing power subject to repayment or agreed collateral/default resolution.
inclusion_test: A lender or issuer creates a repayment obligation.
exclusion_test: A token price target alone does not imply credit; allocating to loans adds MGT.
principal_dependencies: ["oracle", "underwriting", "collateral sale liquidity", "default waterfall", "collateral appraisal", "mint authority", "liquidation", "monetary feedback", "callback", "initiator identity", "fee", "approved asset", "atomic scope"]
representative_implementations: ["Aave V3 market", "Morpho Blue market", "Maple loan", "Maker Vat/Dai", "Aave V3 flashLoan", "Uniswap flash behavior"]

name: Capital formation
definition: Raise resources for an issuer, venture or collective through primary issuance or contributions.
inclusion_test: Resources pass to an issuer/project under a primary funding arrangement.
exclusion_test: Secondary trading is EXC; passive treasury allocation is MGT; ordinary incentive distribution alone is neither.
representative_implementations: ["Balancer V2 liquidity bootstrapping use", "Coverage design", "no measured deployment asserted"]
source_refs: ["P1 Fig1 p2 limited coverage; analyst extension tested by LBP case"]

name: Derivatives and contingent exposure
definition: Create a payoff determined by prices, rates or events rather than ownership of the referenced asset.
inclusion_test: An agreed payoff references a variable or event and has margin, settlement or exercise rules.
exclusion_test: A fully redeemable custody receipt is not automatically a derivative; protection responding to defined loss also has RSK.

representative_implementations: ["Drift perpetual market", "Opyn Gamma option design", "Gnosis Conditional Tokens", "Pendle PT/YT market"]

name: Asset and portfolio management
definition: Allocate or manage capital for a mandate with returns passed to participants.
inclusion_test: An allocator/strategy controls portfolio exposure or its recurring management.
exclusion_test: A container or ERC-4626 ABI alone supplies no mandate; operating the underlying market is a separate function.
principal_dependencies: ["underlying venues", "allocator", "caps", "fees", "unwind liquidity", "valuation", "custody", "manager", "tracking error", "external rights", "venue hooks", "adverse selection", "rebalance execution"]

name: Consensus and shared-security capital services
definition: Commit capital to consensus or other security services in exchange for rewards with specified duties and penalties.
inclusion_test: Capital backs validator/operator duties or is delegated to such exposure.
exclusion_test: Node software alone is a supporting capability; ordinary collateralized borrowing is CRE even if collateral is a staking receipt.
principal_dependencies: ["validator", "chain rewards", "slashing", "exit queue", "operators", "share accounting", "queue", "secondary liquidity", "service rules", "operator", "slashing authority", "collateral reuse"]

name: Protection and loss allocation
definition: Transfer specified loss exposure or assign differentiated loss-bearing obligations to capital.
inclusion_test: A cover, guarantee, tranche or backstop defines who absorbs a loss and on what trigger.
exclusion_test: Ordinary investment loss is not a protection service; a generic price bet is DER.
principal_dependencies: ["claims authority", "exclusions", "capital sufficiency", "dispute process", "underlying default", "valuation", "waterfall implementation", "fund adequacy", "governance", "deficit measurement", "recapitalization"]

name: Monetary issuance and redemption
definition: Issue/cancel units designed for monetary use and define reserve, peg and redemption arrangements.
inclusion_test: An issuer or monetary mechanism creates money-like units.
exclusion_test: Using USDC for a swap does not make the AMM a monetary issuer.

name: Payments and streaming
definition: Transfer value to discharge a payment duty, immediately or over time.
inclusion_test: Receiver obtains a payment or accrued withdrawal entitlement.
exclusion_test: Routing a priced asset exchange is EXC.2; mere token transfer interface is capability.

name: Escrow and conditional settlement
definition: Hold value until agreed release/refund conditions are met.
inclusion_test: A custodied balance secures delivery or another obligation.
exclusion_test: A cross-chain message alone moves no funds and proves no escrow.

name: Trading venues and liquidity provision
definition: Price or match transfers and maintain trading liquidity.
inclusion_test: Traders execute against matched orders or a liquidity inventory.
exclusion_test: A price oracle publishes data; it need not execute trades.

name: Routing and coordinated trade execution
definition: Select and coordinate venues or counterparties to satisfy a trade instruction.
inclusion_test: The service chooses a path, match or fulfillment plan for an exchange.
exclusion_test: A settlement message bus without financial routing is infrastructure.

name: Inventory-funded lending
definition: Lend existing assets against repayment duties, with pooled, isolated or matched funding.
inclusion_test: An agreed financing advance creates repayment duties denominated in an existing asset.
exclusion_test: Pure debt-asset minting is CRE.2, not inventory lending. A solver reimbursement incidental to trade settlement is EXC.2; add CRE.1 only for a separately agreed financing service. An allocator owns MGT.1.

name: Credit issuance
definition: Create new debt units against an obligation to repay or settle collateral.
inclusion_test: The advance increases an issued debt asset supply under a borrower obligation.
exclusion_test: Reserve-backed token subscription without borrower debt is MON.1 only.
asset_position_types: ["issuer debt unit plus separate borrower debt position"]

name: Transaction-scoped liquidity
definition: Advance assets with repayment or an equivalent settlement condition before the enclosing atomic scope ends.
inclusion_test: A callback grants temporary purchasing power and enforces repay-or-revert.
exclusion_test: Same-block timestamps do not provide rollback across transactions.

name: Primary issuance and subscription
definition: Sell or allocate newly issued claims to raise capital.
inclusion_test: A distinct primary offering raises capital for an issuer or project in exchange for newly issued rights.
exclusion_test: Routine deposit receipts or redeemable share accounting for an existing investment mandate are MGT, not automatically capital formation. Add CAP only for a separately identified capital-raising offering. Secondary trading is EXC.1.
source_refs: ["P1 Fig1 p2 limited coverage; analyst extension tested by LBP case"]

name: Conditional collective funding
definition: Pool contributions subject to a funding goal, delivery condition or refund rule.
inclusion_test: Contributor capital finances a project subject to collective conditions.
exclusion_test: An unconditional payment donation is MON.2; treasury investment is MGT.2.
source_refs: ["P1 Fig1 p2 limited coverage; analyst extension tested by LBP case"]

name: Linear price exposure
definition: Provide linear or approximately linear exposure to a reference price with explicit margin/funding/settlement.
inclusion_test: Position payout responds to the referenced price without requiring asset delivery now.
exclusion_test: Holding a redeemable wrapped asset is not sufficient.

name: Optional and structured payoffs
definition: Provide exercise rights or nonlinear combinations of reference-dependent payments.
inclusion_test: Payoff changes nonlinearly or is conditional on exercise/structured thresholds.
exclusion_test: A loss-specific cover also uses RSK; leverage alone is not an option.

name: Event and outcome claims
definition: Allocate payoffs according to a resolved external or on-chain event.
inclusion_test: A resolution rule determines which contingent claims pay.
exclusion_test: Claims paying specifically on insured loss also use RSK.1.

name: Interest and yield exposure transformation
definition: Separate, exchange or hedge future cash-flow/rate exposure.
inclusion_test: A claim changes exposure to future yield or an interest index.
exclusion_test: Fixed-interest debt alone stays CRE.1; a principal strip also records its underlying debt/asset claim.

name: Strategy and credit allocation
definition: Allocate capital among selected strategies or credit venues under a mandate.
inclusion_test: Manager/allocator chooses exposures or limits for participants.
exclusion_test: The lending market itself remains CRE.1; automated execution alone need not pool assets.

name: Portfolio, index and treasury management
definition: Maintain diversified or policy-constrained holdings and manage liquidity for a beneficiary.
inclusion_test: A mandate controls holdings, weights, cash or treasury exposures.
exclusion_test: An index number without an investable mandate is data infrastructure.

name: Liquidity-position management
definition: Choose and maintain exchange liquidity positions for capital owners.
inclusion_test: An agent/strategy manages ranges, inventory or fee reinvestment.
exclusion_test: The exchange pool supplies EXC.1; self-directed LP ownership is a position/strategy.

name: Consensus capital participation and delegation
definition: Commit or delegate capital to consensus validation under reward and penalty rules.
inclusion_test: Capital is exposed to validator duties and consensus withdrawal rules.
exclusion_test: An ERC-20 staking incentive with no security duty is not consensus staking.

name: Liquid security-capital claims
definition: Issue transferable claims on capital committed to consensus or shared security.
inclusion_test: A receipt gives economic exposure to underlying security capital and its exit conditions.
exclusion_test: Liquid receipt collateral in a loan adds CRE, without relabeling the loan as staking.

name: Shared-security allocation
definition: Assign capital-backed security obligations across additional services.
inclusion_test: Committed capital secures additional service duties with defined allocation and penalties.
exclusion_test: Looped lending yield without security duties is not restaking.

name: Protection and cover
definition: Provide payment or loss reimbursement when defined covered conditions are accepted.
inclusion_test: Beneficiary acquires a protection entitlement separate from ordinary asset appreciation.
exclusion_test: Outcome speculation alone is DER.3; transfer controls are not legal insurance.
source_refs: ["P3 threat overlay distinct from function; analyst extension tested by cover case"]

name: Subordination and first-loss capital
definition: Assign differing priorities of loss absorption to claims against shared exposures.
inclusion_test: A contractual waterfall specifies junior/senior treatment.
exclusion_test: Every risky token is not a tranche; priority must be explicit.
source_refs: ["P3 threat overlay distinct from function; analyst extension tested by cover case"]

name: Default and settlement backstops
definition: Commit capital or guarantees to residual shortfalls from financial settlement.
inclusion_test: A reserve or guarantor has a stated role absorbing deficits.
exclusion_test: Protocol revenue retained without a defined backstop is only treasury capital.
